results.snippet: A couple of months ago, I launched StackDigest, a newsletter digest, discovery, and analytics tool. And as people started using it and adding their subscriptions, I started to accumulate a fairly long list of popular newsletters. When I created the vector database to power a semantic search engine that helps users more easily discover Substack content, I collected articles from these newsletters.
